title: netbox-mermaid plugin
description: Meta/visualization NetBox 4.6 plugin: introspects the whole SoT and renders it BOTH as one Mermaid flowchart (curated topology) AND as an exhaustive SoT report in markdown/json/toon (UI + API), with a public-safe sanitize mode on the diagram. No models, no hard deps — the diagram has one apps.is_installed()-guarded collector per in-house plugin (services+host-roles, database, webserver, wordpress, ai, pki, email, federation, cloudflare, lb-acl, pf, dhcp, data-link, wireguard, reticulum, meshcore, zfs, guests); the report is fully generic (walks every netbox_* app + core apps, no per-plugin code). fs/smart/system-services are report-only (no useful topology). All modules py_compile-clean; TOON encoder + report renderers exercised offline. The items below are the deep work owed against a live NetBox.

phases.title: Live-NetBox verification
phases.exit_criteria: The full test suite is green and the UI renders the Mermaid diagram on the pinned NetBox 4.6.

items.description: `python /opt/netbox/app/netbox/manage.py test netbox_mermaid --keepdb -v2` green: test_builder (core graph → flowchart header, ids/labels, nesting, escaping), test_sanitizer (no hostname/IP/secret leak, determinism, count preservation), test_collectors (registry wiring + guarded-skip + kind-id abbreviation uniqueness), test_toon (encoder units), test_report (build_report structure, exhaustive fields, redaction/coercion helpers, markdown/json/toon render), test_api + test_report_api (GET diagram + report per format → 200, content-types, counts, download disposition, auth gate).

Confirm the vendored static/netbox_mermaid/mermaid.min.js draws the flowchart in the NetBox UI under the strict Content-Security-Policy (it exposes globalThis.mermaid), the scope selector + Sanitize toggle round-trip via GET, and the copy/toggle-source buttons work with no inline-script CSP violations.

Confirm the SoT Report page renders under a real prod-scale SoT in all three formats (Markdown table doc, structured JSON, TOON), the format selector + Include-empty toggle round-trip, and Download streams each format with the right content-type/filename. Spot-check secret redaction (no token/password/private_key VALUES; OpenBao path refs retained) and that per-row detail omitted from the diagram (firewall rules, DHCP options, ZFS datasets, SMART, tunables) is present.

Re-confirm each diagram collector's field names against the deployed sibling wheels. A renamed field degrades to a skipped source (guarded import), not a crash, but the collector should track current names so its data appears. The report is field-name-agnostic (generic introspection) and immune to this.

phases.title: Deploy
phases.exit_criteria: Plugin is installed as a wheel on prod + dev NetBox and the SoT Diagram page + API are reachable.

items.description: Build + `uv pip install --no-deps --reinstall` the wheel (with templates + static shipped via package-data) into the NetBox venv (prod pct 74234, dev pct 92254), add netbox_mermaid to PLUGINS, collectstatic, restart once. No migration (model-free). No ObjectPermission grant needed (no models); the API endpoint gates on IsAuthenticated.

phases.title: Extensions
phases.exit_criteria: Optional readability + coverage enhancements as the SoT grows.

items.description: DONE: drop-in collectors added for ai, cloudflare, lb-acl, pf, dhcp, data-link, wireguard, reticulum, meshcore, zfs, guests, and the netbox-services HostRole family — one Collector subclass + one registry line each, with colour/shape/sanitizer-abbr entries. fs/smart/system-services are intentionally report-only (no useful topology). Future plugins: same one-file drop-in.
Wire node click-through to the underlying NetBox object detail page (raw_attrs already carry the identifying detail for tooltips; never emit them into the sanitized diagram).
